accuracy.method: Sum edits / sum reference characters (micro-average). NFC-normalized; standard CER collapses whitespace, compact CER removes it. Neither certifies executable code.
accuracy.reference: Purposive, single-run crops with unblinded assistant-corrected Qwen-derived references fixed before Tesseract. Not independent human gold or representative whole-issue accuracy.
accuracy.index_policy: Post-hoc diagnostic, after seeing both outputs. Identical removal of ASCII period, middle dot, ellipsis and two-dot leader from reference and both engine outputs. Does not remove hallucinated letters/digits, repair names, or pair rows. Primary scores retained; decoration inflates those scores. Unblinded assistant reference, not independent gold.

literal_sensitive_numbered_rows.scope: Only batch05–06 assembly samples; whitespace within single-quoted literals retained. Not all June code.

paired_engine_comparison.scope: Primary matched crops, including two cell-scored tables and three index crops; no extra language reruns. Qwen inference versus Tesseract engine calls, excluding common layout/rendering, Qwen startup and later correction.

local_compute.token_completeness: Observed June inference responses plus separately logged interrupted request; excludes earlier pilot experiments. Unlogged/uncaptured work, if any, is not estimated.
timing_gaps: Batches01–03 have no full-run timer; batch01 preparation_seconds in the old checkpoint is summed monitored stage time, not full preparation.
Superseded/aborted passes in batches20 and23 are not covered by the final-run timers.
Batches28 and32 timers cover recovery only; earlier pass wall time is unavailable.
Do not add retained inference time to run timers: they overlap. Layout mapping, semantic correction, assembly and human review are outside raw-run timers.

earlier_three_page_pilot.scope: Earlier three-page A/B/C development test; separate corpus and scoring, not pooled with June.
limits: A/B/C use identical reviewed geometry; no reference text enters inference.
C requires A+B preparation: its stage_seconds/tokens are incremental, not total workflow cost.
CER and residual edits are reference-based diagnostics, not measured review effort.
Human time and capable-model usage are unknown until recorded; local tokens are measured llama.cpp usage.
One preparation run per arm on three familiar development pages; no generalization or savings claim.
Preparation totals include dependencies: C=A+B+correction; B does not require A.
Times exclude model startup, common image preparation, scoring and human/capable-model correction.
Regression/improvement counts compare with existing references; they are not new human judgments.
Local Qwen token totals are local compute, not billed capable-model tokens.

notes: Local Qwen tokens include image/prompt tokens and generated text, not paid assistant tokens. Tesseract itself consumes no LLM tokens; its downstream correction token use is unknown.
Sampled process-tree RSS includes shared mappings and is not a physical-RAM requirement. GPU peaks are sampled allocations, not energy measurements.
Crop selection and references are unblinded; failures, omissions and graphic placeholders outside scored crops prevent treating CER as final accuracy.
This report reads existing evidence only; no new inference, acceptance or pipeline-default change.
